nodes.name: power_3v3
nodes.description: AMS1117‑3.3 LDO steps VIN_5V down to VCC_3V3 for all digital logic. VIN pin is powered from external 5 V rail; VOUT provides regulated 3.3 V. This module is the sole provider of VCC_3V3 and owns the power‑out port for downstream consumption.

nodes.name: mcu
nodes.description: STM32F103 MCU runs on VCC_3V3. Provides I2C master (SCL output, SDA bi‑directional) to communicate with ADS1115. No on‑board I2C pull‑ups; bias network will be placed in this module. BOOT0 is held low for Flash boot (implicit).

nodes.name: VBAT
nodes.description: Battery backup power supply for RTC, backup registers and LSE oscillator. Connect to VDD if VBAT not used.

nodes.name: PC13

nodes.name: OSC_IN

nodes.name: OSC_OUT
nodes.description: HSE oscillator output (crystal). Can be remapped to PD1 GPIO via AFIO_MAPR register.

nodes.name: NRST

nodes.name: adc
nodes.description: ADS1115 16‑bit I2C ADC powered by VCC_3V3. Operates as I2C slave, receiving SCL from MCU and sharing SDA (open‑drain). Measures two analog inputs: AIN0 receives external sensor voltage, AIN1 monitors the precision 5 V reference output. Configuration pins (ADDR, ALERT) are left at default; no additional external circuitry described.

nodes.name: ADDR
nodes.description: I2C address select. GND=0x48, VDD=0x49, SDA=0x4A, SCL=0x4B.

nodes.name: ALERT
nodes.description: Comparator output / conversion ready, active-low open-drain.

nodes.name: ref_5v
nodes.description: REF5050 precision 5 V reference. Powered directly from VIN_5V. Provides a stable 5 V analog output (VREF_5V) which is routed to the ADC for calibration/reference monitoring. No additional control pins.
5.0V precision voltage reference monitored by ADC
